"""Run finite controls against the real relay probe; no downloads or installations."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone

p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument("phase", choices=("gates",))
p.add_argument("--check-existing", action="store_true",
               help="Validate retained JSON logs without running Go again")
for name in ("source", "work", "module-cache", "build-cache", "goroot", "go", "cc"):
    p.add_argument("--" + name, required=True)
a = p.parse_args()
source, work = Path(a.source), Path(a.work)
phase = work / a.phase

if not a.check_existing:
    phase.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.upper().startswith("MCPHUB_")}
for name in ("tmp", "appdata", "localappdata", "profile", "gopath"):
    (work / name).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
env.update({
    "GOROOT": a.goroot, "GOENV": "off", "GOTOOLCHAIN": "local",
    "GOPROXY": "off", "GOSUMDB": "off", "GOWORK": "off", "GOFLAGS": "",
    "GOCACHE": a.build_cache, "GOMODCACHE": a.module_cache,
    "GOPATH": str(work / "gopath"), "CC": a.cc, "CGO_ENABLED": "1",
    "GOMAXPROCS": "4", "GOTELEMETRY": "off", "MCPHUB_NO_AUTO_GUI": "1",
    "MCPHUB_E2E_SCHEDULER": "none", "USERPROFILE": str(work / "profile"),
    "APPDATA": str(work / "appdata"), "LOCALAPPDATA": str(work / "localappdata"),
    "TEMP": str(work / "tmp"), "TMP": str(work / "tmp"),
    "TMPDIR": str(work / "tmp"), "GOTMPDIR": str(work / "tmp"),
})
env["PATH"] = str(Path(a.cc).parent) + os.pathsep + env.get("PATH", "")


assert subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],cwd=source,text=True).strip()=="a00cbd013348163526b2ec3cd213f27a2c126c70"
assert subprocess.check_output(["git","status","--porcelain"],cwd=source)==b""
records=[]
groups=[("default", [["build","./..."],["vet","./..."],["test","-count=1","-timeout","5m","./..."]]),
        ("state-tag", [["test","-tags=test_state_path_env","-count=1","-timeout","5m","./internal/api/","./internal/cli/"]])]
for group,commands in groups:
    for i,arguments in enumerate(commands):
        name=group+"-"+str(i+1)
        stdout,stderr=phase/(name+".stdout.log"),phase/(name+".stderr.log")
        started=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        with stdout.open("wb") as out,stderr.open("wb") as err:
            result=subprocess.run([a.go,*arguments],cwd=source,env=env,stdout=out,stderr=err,creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
        record={"name":name,"arguments":arguments,"exit_code":result.returncode,
          "started_utc":started,"finished_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          "stdout_sha256":hashlib.sha256(stdout.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          "stderr_sha256":hashlib.sha256(stderr.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          "stdout_bytes":stdout.stat().st_size,"stderr_bytes":stderr.stat().st_size}
        records.append(record)
        (phase/"commands.json").write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
        print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
        if result.returncode: break
print(json.dumps({"final_head":subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],cwd=source,text=True).strip(),"status":subprocess.check_output(["git","status","--porcelain"],cwd=source,text=True)}),flush=True)
sys.exit(0 if all(r["exit_code"]==0 for r in records) else 1)
